title: What the looks cost
questions: How much do the looks cost?
How many stars is Midnight Teal?
How many stars do I need for Sunset Copper?
How much do the outfits cost?
How many stars is the Astronaut outfit?
answer: My Robert Original look is free. For new colours, Sunset Copper costs 5 stars, Dune Walker costs 15 stars and Midnight Teal costs 30 stars. For outfits, Casual costs 10 stars, Gardener and Arab Thobe cost 20 stars each, Explorer and Cowboy cost 25 stars each, and Astronaut costs 35 stars.
